weekLabel: Mon Nov 30 cook · Mon Nov 30 – Sun Dec 6
notes: 3 people (Rory, Wendy, Chloe; Ava not counted). We drive home from Pigeon Forge Sun Nov 29, so the batch cook moves to MONDAY Nov 30 (delivery Monday morning, ~2½ hr session from 1 PM, roast dinner ~5:35). Fridge = Mon–Thu meals; Fri onward frozen Monday. Tue Dec 1 = car-jar dinner after dance + Wendy's bowl at home; Wed Dec 2 = music class 3:30 (Pompano), easy 25-min salmon; Sat Dec 5 = night out; Sun Dec 6 = next week's batch cook. Mild for Chloe and Wendy, heat on the side for Rory. Quality: organic; beef grass-fed/finished; chicken organic AND air-chilled only (Whole Foods); seafood wild-caught; eggs OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free; yogurt Maple Hill grass-fed Greek (Publix). Rice in bone broth; gelatin in beef. Low oil. Named low-cal sides. No cabbage. Macros are estimates.

dinners.name: Rory's Mild Apple-Ginger Braised Chuck Roast + honey-ginger carrots
dinners.desc: Cook-day dinner, made inside Monday's session: the household favorite, Rory's original method and original liquid amounts (no sear, miso + tomato paste, gelatin in the broth, 325°F covered ~4 hours, shredded into its juices). In the oven by 1:15 PM so it braises while we do the batch; at 5:15 it's just shred, glaze the carrots and plate. Makes Tuesday's car jars, Wendy's Tue bowl and Chloe's Thursday lunch.

recipe.serves: 3 tonight (cooked beef: Rory 170 g · Wendy 140 · Chloe 70) + 360 g for Tue jars/bowl + 70 g for Chloe's Thu lunch (~140 g spare)
recipe.time: 15 min prep · ~4 hr covered at 325°F · in the oven by 1:15 PM · dinner ~5:35
ingredients: 3.5 lb (1.59 kg) grass-fed chuck roast, cut into 3 big chunks (fridge, from Monday morning's delivery)
1 apple, grated (~180 g)
1 medium yellow onion, diced (~150 g)
4 garlic cloves, minced
10 g fresh ginger, grated (1-in piece)
42 g (2 Tbsp) honey
30 g (2 Tbsp) apple cider vinegar
120 g (½ cup) low-sodium tamari
480 g (2 cups) organic bone broth, the only other liquid. Bloom 10 g (1½ Tbsp) gelatin in 60 g of this measured broth.
14 g (1 Tbsp) toasted sesame oil
16 g (1 Tbsp) tomato paste + 6 g (1 tsp) white miso whisked into a little of the broth
1½ tsp kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper. No oil, no sear.
Optional: 1 cinnamon stick + 1 star anise for the first 3 hours; sliced green onion + sesame seeds to finish
320 g bone broth rice (today's batch, still warm): Rory 120 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 90
Rory only: chili crisp or hot sauce on the side
steps: 1:00 PM: oven to 325°F, rack low enough for the covered ceramic pot (5–6 qt Dutch oven works too).
Pat the chuck dry, season all sides with the salt and pepper. No sear: straight into the pot.
Add the apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, tamari, broth with the bloomed gelatin, sesame oil, tomato paste and miso. Turn the beef to coat. Cinnamon/star anise in if using.
By 1:15: lid on tight, braise ~4 hours undisturbed. Pull the cinnamon/star anise at ~4:15.
5:15: done when it shreds easily with two forks (~200–205°F inside). If it resists, 20–30 min more (dinner just slides to 6).
Shred in the pot and toss through the juices. If thin, simmer uncovered on the stove 5–8 min until it coats the beef.
Before plating, pack: Tue container 360 g beef + ½ cup juices (FRIDGE) and Chloe's Thu container 70 g beef + 1 Tbsp juices + 100 g rice (FRIDGE; Thu is inside the Mon–Thu window).
Rory: 170 g beef with juices, 120 g rice, 150 g carrots ≈ 585 cal / 52 g P.
recipe.scale: Rory's original is written for a 3–4 lb roast, so 3.5 lb is 1× with his original liquid amounts (½ cup tamari, 2 cups broth, 2 Tbsp honey, 2 Tbsp vinegar).
recipe.leftovers: 360 g → Tue car jars + Wendy's Tue bowl (fridge). 70 g → Chloe's Thu lunch (fridge). ~140 g spare → Rory's breakfast eggs Tue/Wed.

sideRecipes.title: Honey-ginger broth-glazed carrots (start 5:20)
sideRecipes.serves: ~420 g cooked (Rory 150 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 60; rest for snacks)
ingredients: 500 g organic carrots (from the 2 lb bag), peeled, cut in ¼-in coins
100 g bone broth
8 g honey
5 g fresh ginger, grated
¼ tsp kosher salt, squeeze of lemon
steps: 10-in stainless skillet with a lid: carrots + broth + ginger, covered over medium-high 7–8 min until just tender.
Uncover, add the honey and salt, cook 3–4 min more, tossing, until the liquid is a glaze. Lemon to finish.

sideRecipes.title: Lemon-oregano chicken breasts (Monday: 7 'fire' lunches + Chloe's Tue lunch)
sideRecipes.serves: 4.5 lb raw → ~1,430 g cooked (weigh actual yield): Rory 4 × 200 g · Wendy 3 × 150 g · Chloe Tue 70 g · ~110 g spare
sideRecipes.time: 15 min + ~60 min air fryer (3 batches, mostly hands-off)
ingredients: 4.5 lb (2.04 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken breasts, thick ends pounded to ¾ in (fridge, from Monday's delivery)
Zest of 2 lemons + 50 g lemon juice
4 g (2 tsp) dried oregano, 7 g (2½ tsp) garlic powder, 3 g (1½ tsp) smoked paprika
13 g (2¼ tsp) kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon, spices and salt in a big glass bowl; spray lightly.
Air-fry ~1½ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min (single layer, don't stack; split into a 4th batch if it crowds), flipping halfway, to 165°F in the thickest part. Batches at ~1:35, 1:55, 2:15.
Rest 5 min on a board, slice, and weigh into containers in the 2:45 step.

sideRecipes.title: 'Fire' lunch boxes: Rory ×4 (Tue–Fri) + Wendy ×3 (Tue–Thu), peas and carrots, aji verde
sideRecipes.serves: 7 lunches + Chloe's Wed fried-rice veg + Rory's Tue car-jar cup
ingredients: Chicken from above: Rory 4 × 200 g, Wendy 3 × 150 g
Bone broth rice (today's batch): 7 × 120 g = 840 g

Peas and carrots (need ~940 g cooked): 3 × 16 oz bags organic frozen peas and carrots, 90 g bone broth, ¾ tsp salt, 1½ tsp honey, juice of ½ lemon. Rory 150 g per box, Wendy 100 g per box, + 40 g for Chloe's Wed fried rice; extra into Wendy's boxes.

Aji verde, one Monday batch (~310 g, Tue–Fri): 220 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, 38 g cilantro (stems ok), 20 g grated parmesan, 20 g lime juice, 1 large garlic clove, 4 g salt. Blend smooth. Rory's heat: blend ½ jalapeño into his cups only.
steps: Peas and carrots in 2 batches: 12-in stainless pan, covered, with 45 g broth each, medium heat 6–7 min until hot; season with salt, honey and lemon. Spread on a plate to cool 10 min.
Blend the aji verde 30 s. Portion 7 lidded steel cups × 40 g (Rory Tue–Fri, Wendy Tue–Thu) + 1 × 30 g for Rory's Tue car jar. Blend ½ jalapeño into Rory's 5 cups. Fridge (eat by Fri).
Rory's boxes (×4): 200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas and carrots. Wendy's boxes (×3): 150 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots. Glass or U-Konserve steel containers only.
FRIDGE: Rory Tue/Wed/Thu + Wendy Tue/Wed/Thu. FREEZER: Rory Fri (move to the fridge Thu night).
Reheat: lid off/cracked (glass), microwave 2½–3 min from the fridge to 165°F, stirring once; add the aji verde cold after.
Rory's box ≈ 623 cal · 77 g P · 52 g C · 10 g F with 40 g aji verde. Wendy's ≈ 497 cal · 61 g P.

sideRecipes.title: Chloe's Tue + Thu containers (packed Monday, fridge)
ingredients: Tue: 70 g lemon-oregano chicken + 100 g bone broth rice
Thu: 70 g apple-ginger beef + 1 Tbsp juices (no heat) + 100 g bone broth rice (packed at 5:15 with the roast)
Wed: 100 g rice + 40 g peas and carrots in one small glass container (for her fried rice)
steps: All three go in the FRIDGE (Mon–Thu window).
Morning of: heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 4–6 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated 12 oz LunchBots jar; fruit in the steel bento with an ice pack.

dinners.name: Car dinner after dance (Rory + Chloe): apple-ginger beef rice jars · Wendy's bowl at home
dinners.desc: Monday's shredded apple-ginger beef over bone broth rice, packed hot in thermal jars to eat in the car after dance, with cucumber/pepper spears on the side (Rory gets an aji verde cup). Wendy has the same bowl at home with a fried OrgaNICK egg and green onion on top. 15 minutes before you leave.
dinners.side: Cucumber + red bell pepper spears (+ apple slices for Chloe)

recipe.serves: 3: Rory + Chloe in the car, Wendy at home (beef: Rory 150 g · Chloe 70 · Wendy 140)
recipe.time: 15 min before you leave for dance
ingredients: 360 g shredded beef + ½ cup juices (fridge, Monday)
370 g bone broth rice (fridge, Monday): Rory 150 · Chloe 100 · Wendy 120, + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory: 30 g aji verde cup with jalapeño (Monday batch)
Spears: 1 English cucumber + 1 red bell pepper in sticks (~300 g; Rory 150 g, Chloe 60 g, Wendy 80 g); 1 small apple sliced for Chloe
Wendy: 1 OrgaNICK egg, fried with spray; 1 green onion sliced
Gear: Chloe's 12 oz LunchBots thermal jar + a second wide-mouth steel thermal jar for Rory, insulated bag, steel ice pack for the spears + sauce, forks, napkins; Rory's chili crisp/hot sauce
steps: Preheat both jars with boiling water 5–10 min; dump.
Heat the beef with its juices in a covered stainless skillet over medium 4–5 min, stirring, to 165°F (steaming).
Warm the rice covered with 2 Tbsp broth (glass bowl, microwave 2–3 min) to steaming.
Jars: rice first, beef + juices on top, lids on tight. Spears, apple and the aji verde cup in the bento with the ice pack. Eat within 4 hours (jars hold above 140°F about 4–5 hours).
Wendy (at home): reheat her beef + rice to 165°F, fry the egg 2–3 min with a lid for 30 s, top with green onion; spears on the side.
Rory: 150 g beef, 150 g rice, 30 g aji verde, 150 g spears ≈ 576 cal / 51 g P.
Tonight: salmon is already thawing (moved Mon night). Move the chicken thighs to the fridge for Thursday.

dinners.name: Miso-honey-ginger wild salmon + sesame-garlic asparagus (easy music-class night)
dinners.desc: Chloe's music class is 3:30–4:30 in Pompano Beach, so this is the easy one: one sheet-pan salmon, one pan of asparagus and Monday's rice, about 25 minutes from walking in. Mild white-miso, honey and ginger glaze; chili crisp on the side for Rory.

ingredients: 1.25 lb (567 g) wild-caught sockeye, cut in 3 portions (frozen on delivery; fridge Mon night)
Glaze (~45 g): 15 g white miso, 12 g honey, 8 g coconut aminos, 4 g fresh ginger grated, 1 garlic clove grated, 5 g lime juice

Sesame-garlic asparagus (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40): 1.5 lb asparagus (2 bunches), woody ends snapped (~450 g trimmed); spray, ½ tsp salt, 1 garlic clove grated, 1 tsp (5 g) toasted sesame oil tossed on after roasting, 3 g toasted sesame seeds
320 g bone broth rice (fridge, Monday): Rory 120 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 90, + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory only: chili crisp or sriracha on the side
steps: 5:00: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle; 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans. Whisk the glaze.
Asparagus on pan B: spray, salt, garlic; in at 5:05 on the lower rack, 12–14 min until tender-crisp, shaking once. Toss with the sesame oil and seeds.
Pat the salmon dry, skin-side down on pan A (sprayed), salt lightly, brush on ⅔ of the glaze.
5:10: salmon on the upper rack 9–11 min, then broil 1–2 min (watch it) until the glaze bubbles and the thickest part is 145°F / flakes. Pull Chloe's piece 2 min early. Brush on the rest of the glaze.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min to steaming.
Rory: 190 g cooked salmon, 120 g rice, 150 g asparagus ≈ 574 cal / 58 g P.
Tonight: sirloin → fridge (Fri). Mix the kebab marinade and toss the thighs (or Thu morning, ≥2 hr).

dinners.name: Sheet-pan shawarma chicken thigh kebabs + garlic yogurt + rice
dinners.desc: Rotation keeper (the Mediterranean kebab), made with organic AIR-CHILLED thigh chunks instead of ground chicken (no air-chilled guarantee on ground, and no water problem): tomato paste, sumac, smoked paprika, cumin, lemon and garlic, roasted hot and broiled for char. Toum-style garlic Maple Hill yogurt, bone broth rice and a sumac tomato-cucumber salad. Mild; Aleppo on the side for Rory. Makes Wendy's Friday lunch and Saturday lunch for Rory + Wendy.
dinners.side: Sumac tomato-cucumber salad (cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, parsley, lemon; no oil)

recipe.serves: 3 + Wendy's Fri lunch + Sat lunch for Rory + Wendy (cooked: Rory 190 g · Wendy 150 · Chloe 70 · Wendy Fri 150 · Sat Rory 190 + Wendy 150)
recipe.time: Marinate ≥2 hr (Wed night or Thu AM) · 35 min at 425°F
ingredients: 3 lb (1.36 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken thighs, trimmed, cut in 1½-in chunks (frozen on delivery; fridge Tue night)

Marinade (no oil): 32 g (2 Tbsp) tomato paste, zest of 1 lemon + 30 g lemon juice, 4 garlic cloves grated, 60 g grated yellow onion squeezed, 15 g parsley chopped fine, 6 g (1 Tbsp) smoked paprika, 5 g (2 tsp) sumac, 2 g (1 tsp) cumin, 1 g (½ tsp) turmeric, 8 g (1⅓ tsp) kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper

Toum-style garlic yogurt (~165 g; Rory 40 · Wendy 35 · Chloe 15 · Wendy Fri 25 · Sat 25 + 25): 150 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, 1 small garlic clove grated, 10 g lemon juice, 2 g smoked paprika, 1.5 g salt, 1 tsp water

Sumac tomato-cucumber salad (~400 g; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40 · Wendy Fri 60): 200 g cherry tomatoes quartered, ½ English cucumber diced (~170 g), 25 g red onion sliced thin, 10 g parsley, 3 g sumac, 12 g lemon juice, ¼ tsp salt (at the table)
300 g bone broth rice (fridge, Monday): Rory 110 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 80, + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory only: Aleppo pepper or red pepper flakes
steps: 4:45: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle. 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans, sprayed.
Spread the marinated chunks in ONE layer across both pans with space between them (crowding = steaming). Spray the tops.
4:55: roast 18–20 min, swapping racks at 10, until 175°F inside. Then one pan at a time under the broiler 2–3 min for char (watch it).
While it roasts: stir the garlic yogurt; make the salad (salt it at the table so it stays crisp).
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 3 min to steaming.

Pack first: Wendy's Fri lunch 150 g kebab + 60 g salad + 25 g yogurt (+ her frozen rice moved to the fridge tonight); Sat lunch 190 g (Rory) + 150 g (Wendy) kebab + 2 × 25 g yogurt in glass (fridge, eat Sat).
Rory: 190 g kebab, 110 g rice, 40 g garlic yogurt, 150 g salad ≈ 571 cal / 59 g P.
Tonight: Rory's Fri box, Wendy's Fri rice and the Sat lunch rice → fridge. Make the chimichurri.

dinners.name: Steak night: seared grass-fed sirloin + chimichurri
dinners.desc: Rotation winner ('absolute banger'): hard-seared grass-fed top sirloin, low-oil chimichurri (red pepper flakes only in Rory's), oven-roasted Yukon potatoes at 425°F on two pans (oven, not air fryer), lemon-garlic green beans.
dinners.side: Oven-roasted Yukon potatoes + lemon-garlic green beans

ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) grass-fed top sirloin, ~1 in thick (frozen on delivery; fridge Wed night)
1 tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, avocado-oil spray

Chimichurri (~100 g): 30 g flat-leaf parsley chopped fine, 2 garlic cloves minced, ¾ tsp dried oregano, 20 g red wine vinegar, 10 g lemon juice, 18 g (4 tsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 20 g water, ⅓ tsp kosher salt, pinch of pepper. Rory's portion: + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes. Make Thu night; rest 15 min+.
Potatoes: 650 g Yukon Golds in 1-in chunks, split across 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans, spray, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika (Rory 180 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 80 cooked)
Lemon-garlic green beans (~260 g cooked; Rory 120 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40): 300 g green beans trimmed, 100 g bone broth, 2 garlic cloves sliced, zest of ½ lemon + 1 tsp juice, ¼ tsp salt
steps: 4:45: salt the steaks; counter 30–40 min. Oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle.
5:00: potatoes in (both pans), 30–35 min, shaking at 15 and 25 min and swapping racks once, until deep golden.
5:15: green beans in a wide lidded stainless pan with the broth and garlic: covered 6–7 min, then uncover and cook off the liquid 1–2 min; zest, juice, salt.

5:20: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high 3 min, spray, sear the steaks 4–5 min per side to 130–135°F for medium-rare (USDA: 145°F; Chloe's piece to 145°F if she prefers). Rest 5–10 min, slice against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced steak (Rory's from his spicy portion).
Rory: 170 g cooked sirloin, 180 g potatoes, 120 g green beans, 25 g chimichurri ≈ 572 cal / 58 g P.

dinners.name: Night out
dinners.desc: Saturday is our standing night out. No prep, nothing bought for it. Lunch = Thursday's leftover kebabs (Rory 190 g, Wendy 150 g) with the rice frozen Monday and cucumber spears.

dinners.name: Next week's Sunday batch cook
dinners.desc: Back to the normal rhythm: Sun Dec 6 is the batch cook for the week of Dec 7–13, planned and ordered with next Thursday's (Dec 3) list. Nothing bought for it this week.

chloeLunches.items: 4–5 Bell & Evans organic nuggets + ~100 g potato wedges, 2 Tbsp honey mustard (1 Tbsp honey + 1 Tbsp Dijon) in a steel dip cup, ½ mango in chunks + 1 kiwi
chloeLunches.how: LFMS's Thanksgiving break runs Nov 20–30 per the school's email, so this is likely lunch at home after the delivery. If school is in session, it needs a nugget bag already in the freezer. Cut 1 Yukon potato (~180 g) into 8 wedges, spray, pinch of salt; air-fry 400°F 8 min. Add the nuggets from frozen, 10–12 min more at 400°F, shaking at 6 min, to 170°F (they're sold uncooked). If packing: hot into the preheated jar, mango + dip in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Mild lemon chicken + rice: 70 g lemon-oregano chicken over 100 g bone broth rice (packed Monday, fridge); 1 small apple sliced + 1 kiwi
chloeLunches.how: Heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 4–5 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar. Fruit in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Mild veggie egg fried rice: 100 g bone broth rice + 2 OrgaNICK eggs + 40 g peas and carrots (packed Monday), 1 tsp coconut aminos, ½ tsp toasted sesame oil; 1 mandarin + 4 strawberries
chloeLunches.how: Spray a 10-in stainless pan, scramble the eggs soft and set aside; add the rice, peas and carrots and 1 Tbsp broth, 3–4 min until steaming; fold in the eggs, aminos and sesame oil (165°F). Pack hot.

chloeLunches.items: Mild apple-ginger beef + rice: 70 g Monday's shredded beef + 1 Tbsp juices + 100 g bone broth rice (packed Monday, fridge); 1 kiwi + a handful of blueberries
chloeLunches.how: Heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 5–6 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar. Fruit in the bento with an ice pack.

breakfasts: Yogurt bowls: Maple Hill grass-fed Greek yogurt + berries, kiwi or mango, honey optional, no granola (Maple Hill: 160 cal / 15 g P per 170 g).

Eggs: 2 dozen OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free (fried or scrambled with spray); Rory's Mon lunch (4), Wendy's Tue bowl (1), Chloe's Wed fried rice (2). Spare roast beef goes into Rory's Tue/Wed breakfast eggs.

Rory's daily snacks (unchanged): Jacob bar pre-workout; 3 PM = 136 g Maple Hill + 35 g Equip chocolate peanut butter + 182 g apple. Dessert (a third of a Creami pint) right after dinner, then nothing until bed. First pints are ready Tue night (24 h freeze).
lunches: Grown-up lunches: Mon Nov 30 (before the cook) = Rory 4 OrgaNICK eggs scrambled with spray + 170 g Maple Hill + kiwi; Wendy the same at her portion. Rory's 'fire' box Tue–Fri (200 g lemon-oregano chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + 150 g peas and carrots + 40 g aji verde, ≈ 623 cal / 77 g P; Fri box frozen Monday). Wendy's box Tue–Thu (150 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots + 40 g aji verde). Wendy's Fri lunch = Thursday's kebabs + rice frozen Monday. Sat lunch = Thursday's kebabs for Rory + Wendy with the frozen rice and cucumber spears.

creami.name: Honey vanilla ×2

creami.name: Notes
creami.desc: Make Monday (1:40 step), freeze level 24 h, first spin Tue night. Blend each base 30–45 s, fill to the max line. Re-spin with 15–30 g milk if crumbly. Totals for 6 pints: Maple Hill 890 g · cottage cheese 640 g · milk 150 g · water 340 g · Noble 126 g · 1 scoop Equip chocolate PB · mango 230 g · strawberries 220 g · cocoa 8 g · honey 48 g · vanilla 6 g · pistachio butter 25 g. Macros are estimates (Noble 24 g ≈ 90 cal / 20 g P).

prep.title: Delivery (aim 9–11 AM)
prep.step: FREEZE on arrival: salmon, sirloin, chicken thighs, nuggets (minus Chloe's lunch portion). FRIDGE: chuck roast + chicken breasts (cooked this afternoon). Maple Hill from Publix straight to the fridge. Lunch: eggs + Maple Hill (grown-ups), nuggets + wedges (Chloe).

prep.title: Roast in first
prep.step: Oven to 325°F. Bloom the gelatin in 60 g of the measured broth. Season the chuck (no sear) and into the ceramic pot with the apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, tamari, broth, sesame oil, tomato paste + miso. Lid on; in the oven by 1:15. Done ~5:15.

prep.title: Bone broth rice (big batch)
prep.step: Rinse 1,100 g jasmine. Two 4–5 qt stainless saucepans: each 550 g rice + 950 g bone broth + ½ tsp salt. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min → ~2,750 g (weigh; need ~2,710 g). Spread on 2 sheet pans to cool; fridge/freezer within 1 hr. Keep 320 g covered for tonight.

prep.title: Lunch chicken (air fryer, 3 batches)
prep.step: Pound and season 4.5 lb air-chilled breasts lemon-oregano. Air-fry ~1½ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min, flipping halfway, to 165°F: batches at ~1:35, 1:55, 2:15. Rest each batch on a board.

prep.title: Creami bases (6 pints)
prep.step: Between air-fryer flips: blend and fill 2 honey vanilla, 1 chocolate PB, 1 mango, 1 strawberry-honey, 1 pistachio. Lids on, freeze level. ~35 min.

prep.title: Aji verde
prep.step: Blend 220 g Maple Hill, 38 g cilantro, 20 g parmesan, 20 g lime, 1 garlic clove, 4 g salt. 7 steel cups × 40 g + 1 × 30 g (Rory's Tue jar); ½ jalapeño into Rory's 5. Fridge.

prep.title: Peas and carrots
prep.step: 3 bags frozen peas and carrots in 2 batches, covered with 45 g broth each, 6–7 min; season with salt, honey, lemon. Spread to cool 10 min.

prep.title: Portion + label (scale out)
prep.step: FRIDGE: Rory boxes Tue/Wed/Thu (200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas/carrots) · Wendy boxes Tue/Wed/Thu (150 + 120 + 100) · Chloe Tue (70 g chicken + 100 g rice) · Chloe Wed (100 g rice + 40 g peas/carrots) · Tue rice 370 g · Wed rice 320 g · Thu rice 300 g + 100 g for Chloe's Thu (packed with the roast). FREEZER: Rory Fri box · Wendy Fri rice 120 g · Sat lunch rice 2 × 120 g. Label dish / day / grams / 'cooked 11/30'.

prep.title: Fruit + clean up
prep.step: Wash and cut fruit for bowls (kiwi, strawberries, blueberries); leave mangoes, apples and mandarins whole. Clean up; done ~3:30 (≈ 2½ hr hands-on). Break until 5:10.

prep.title: Carrots prep
prep.step: Peel and coin 500 g carrots into the 10-in skillet with 100 g broth + 5 g ginger.

prep.title: Roast out + shred; carrots on
prep.step: Check it shreds easily (~200–205°F); if not, 20–30 min more. Carrots on: covered 7–8 min, then glaze 3–4 min. Shred the beef into its juices; reduce 5 min if thin.

prep.title: Pack beef
prep.step: Tue container 360 g beef + ½ cup juices → fridge. Chloe's Thu container 70 g beef + 1 Tbsp juices + 100 g rice → fridge. Warm tonight's 320 g rice with 2 Tbsp broth.

prep.title: Dinner
prep.step: Plate beef, rice, carrots; chili crisp for Rory. Mon night: salmon → fridge (for Wed).

prep.title: Thaw + to-do schedule
prep.step: Mon night: salmon → fridge (Wed). Tue night: chicken thighs → fridge (Thu). Wed night: sirloin → fridge (Fri); marinate the thighs (or Thu AM). Thu night: Rory's Fri box, Wendy's Fri rice, Sat lunch rice → fridge; pack Wendy's Fri lunch + Sat lunch kebabs; make chimichurri.

prepNote: Mon Nov 30 (cook day, after Sunday's ~12-hour drive home from Pigeon Forge): delivery Monday morning; roast in by 1:15; rice, 4.5 lb lunch chicken, 6 Creami, aji verde, peas and carrots and portioning 1:15–3:30 while it braises; carrots + dinner ~5:35. Fridge = Mon–Thu meals; Fri onward frozen today.

lunchIntro: Every morning: fill the 12 oz LunchBots thermal jar with boiling water 5–10 min, dump, pack food heated to 165°F, close. Cold food (fruit, dips) in the steel bento with a steel ice pack, all in the insulated bag. Every lunch has a real carb (rice or potatoes); fruit is the side. Mon Nov 30 is most likely still Thanksgiving break (school email: Nov 20–30).
prepIntro: Monday cook day (no Sunday cook this week; we're driving home from Tennessee Sun Nov 29). Times assume the delivery is in by ~11 AM and a 1:00 PM start. About 2½ hours hands-on, 1:00–3:30 (the air fryer runs 3 chicken batches while you do Creami and sauces), a break while the roast finishes, then ~25 minutes at 5:10 for carrots and plating. Tuesday is the car-jar dinner (15 min), Wednesday is a 25-minute salmon after music class, Thu/Fri are cooked fresh (35–40 min), Saturday is the night out.
prepSafety: Chicken 165°F (thighs best at 175°F); salmon 145°F; steak 130–135°F medium-rare (USDA 145°F); chuck shreds at ~200–205°F; reheated leftovers 165°F. Bell & Evans nuggets are sold uncooked: cook to 170°F.
Cool fast: spread rice on sheet pans; everything into the fridge within 1–2 hours (rice within 1 hour).
Fridge = eaten Mon–Thu (Rory + Wendy boxes Tue–Thu, Chloe Tue/Wed/Thu, Tue beef, Tue–Thu dinner rice, aji verde through Fri). Freezer = Fri onward (Rory's Fri box, Wendy's Fri rice, Sat lunch rice).

Thermal jars: preheat with boiling water, pack food at 165°F, eat within 4 hours. Reheat each portion only once, in glass or a stainless pan (no plastic). Label every container with dish, day, grams and 'cooked 11/30'.
prepThaw: Mon Nov 30 (delivery morning): freeze the salmon, sirloin, thighs and nuggets right away; chuck and breasts go in the fridge for the afternoon cook.
Tue night: 3 lb thighs → fridge (for Thu).
Wed night: 1.5 lb sirloin → fridge (for Fri); thigh chunks into the kebab marinade (or Thu AM, ≥2 hr).
Thu night: Rory's Fri box, Wendy's Fri rice and the Sat lunch rice → fridge; pack Wendy's Fri lunch and Sat lunch kebabs; make the chimichurri.
Saturday: night out; lunch is Thursday's kebabs.
groceryNote: Schedule delivery for Monday Nov 30 morning (we're driving home Sunday). Check off anything we already have in Todoist > Home & Family > Thursday Order; only open items get ordered.
